G00: Rapid traverse: fast non-cutting positioning move.
G01: Linear interpolation: straight feed move at the programmed F feedrate.
G17: Select XY plane for arcs and cutter compensation.
G21: Metric programming: all coordinates and feedrates in millimetres.
G28: Return to machine home via an intermediate point (here used with G91 Z0 to send the tool straight up).
G43: Tool length compensation positive. Applies the H offset; call it on the first Z move after every tool change, with H matching the T number.
G54: Work coordinate system 1: the part zero used by this program.
G55: Work coordinate system 2: a second part zero (on this machine a stale offset 25 mm low).
G90: Absolute programming: coordinates are positions from part zero.
G91: Incremental programming: coordinates are distances from the current point.
M03: Spindle on clockwise at the programmed S speed.
M06: Tool change to the tool called by T. Command G43 with the H number matching the new tool on the first Z move after every tool change.
M30: End of program: stops spindle, coolant and rewinds.
